name: Heart-shaped tea hills
kicker: Contour tea rows above Tan Lap
summary: Walk the contour rows at Tan Lap when the plateau is the picture you came for. Vietnam Tourism calls the tea ground about 3,000 ha and the largest tea region in Vietnam. A 2019 paper also says more than 3,000 ha and says the tea is less famous than Thai Nguyen. Those lines do not settle the size. The 2019 free-entry line is not a 2026 fee.
getThere: From the farm town toward Tan Lap. The 2019 turns are old.
heroCaption: Contour tea, a path, and the ridge in the late light. Not an aerial of the heart.

notice.title: Do not sit on the bushes
notice.body: A 2019 paper asks visitors not to sit or lie on the tea. The same paper’s free-entry line is not a 2026 fee. Check the gate on arrival.

body: Walk the contour rows at Tan Lap. From above, some of the hills read as a heart. What you walk through is the rows, the path, and the peak. A 2019 paper names at least three hills. The turns it prints are old. Check them on arrival.

Vietnam Tourism says the wider tea ground is about 3,000 ha and calls Moc Chau the largest tea region in Vietnam. The 2019 paper also says more than 3,000 ha, and says the tea is less famous than Thai Nguyen tea. Those two lines stay side by side.
The 2019 paper, citing a tea-ground site, said the hills charged no ticket. That is not a 2026 tariff. The fee, the hours, and how long the walk takes are check on arrival.

figures.caption: The same rows in the morning, with the peak and a path
figures.alt: Green contour tea rows, a bare tree, and a peak above Tan Lap in the morning

gettingThere: The hills are at Tan Lap, reached from the farm town. A 26 Dec 2019 provincial feature gives routes that are now old: about 7 km toward Tan Lap then 500 m for the Taiwan hill, a longer continuation for Moc Suong, and about 5 km plus 3 km for a farm-town hill the paper said would open in early 2020. Minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the farm town
legs.body: Road toward Tan Lap. The 2019 distances are about 7 km then 500 m, a longer continuation toward Moc Suong, or about 5 km plus 3 km for the farm-town hill. Those turns are old. Check them on arrival. The minutes were not published.

closed: No weekly closing day is published. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: The 2019 paper said the hills charged no ticket. Do not use that line as the 2026 fee. Child and senior prices were not published. The fee is check on arrival.
